giver: Jason, at his house in Key Lento
steps: Drive Jason's '70 Ganado to the marker at his house
Talk to Joey outside the garage
Choose Full Engine for the free repair
Open Cosmetics > Respray and pick any color
tips: If the Ganado was destroyed, reload a manual save so it respawns outside the house
Upgrades on this car are lost once your personal vehicle is replaced
You can't register stolen cars as your personal vehicle until Chapter 2
